answer: Attackers creating thousands of fake identities face escalating costs, since every clone demands fresh stake and energy. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-work tied to scarce physical resources: each new agent identity must burn verifiable compute and stake tokens that decay in a spiral over time. Honest agents on the frozen tundra of cheap hardware still earn an echo of their stake back through useful work. The result: mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
